incidents.summary: Rank Group agreed a £5 million regulatory settlement over anti-money laundering and social responsibility failures in its land-based casino network.

sources.title: Gambling Commission confirms £5m Rank Group sanction over AML and RG failings - EGR Intel
sources.quote: The Gambling Commission (GC) has confirmed it has reached a £5m settlement with Rank Group over anti-money laundering (AML) and social responsibility violations.

sources.title: Gambling Commission confirms £5m Rank Group sanction over AML and RG failings - EGR Intel
sources.quote: Social responsibility violations included failing to carry out safer gambling interactions with a customer during a period in which they lost £50,000.

sources.title: Gambling Commission confirms £5m Rank Group sanction over AML and RG failings - EGR Intel
sources.quote: “As also indicated at the time of the group’s 2025/26 preliminary results, remedial actions have been substantially completed.”
